profile.headline: Software Engineer at The Pokémon Company International
profile.summary: I'm a passionate frontend engineer with full-stack experience, with a strong focus on architecting and building projects from start to finish. I enjoy collaborating with stakeholders to define the vision, working alongside designers to shape the user experience, and tackling technical challenges that help me grow as an engineer. I’m always eager to learn, solve problems, and contribute to creating impactful, high-quality software.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Working on applications and services to support the Organized Play team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Contributed to feature development on the Consumer and Enterprise DIGITS platform, focusing on messaging functionality. Specialized in WebRTC for video calling and conferencing, ensuring seamless communication across both platforms.

positions.title: Assistant Teacher
positions.description: At Creative Coding, I assisted in introducing students to the concept of computer science using Scratch, a visual programming language developed by MIT. I taught students between the ages of 6 to 12 how to approach solving problems, debug and test their code. The skill level of each student varies, so I've learned to adapt my teaching to each student's needs as well as effective classroom management.
